_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: categories
constraints: CHECK (system_key IS NOT NULL OR name IS NOT NULL)

data.name: vault_transactions
constraints: CHECK (type <> 'withdraw' OR (reason_note IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason_note)) > 0))

data.name: allocation_rules
constraints: CHECK (basis_points IS NOT NULL OR fixed_amount_minor IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (basis_points IS NULL OR basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
